questions.def: "Would" is used for polite requests and offers.
questions.question: ___ you like to go to the park?

questions.def: Use "-er" for short adjectives in comparative form.
questions.question: This car is ___ than my old one.

questions.def: "Best" is the superlative form of "good".
questions.question: This is the ___ book I have ever read.

questions.def: "Which" is used when choosing from a set of options.
questions.question: ___ is the tallest building in the city?

questions.def: "As...as" is used for equal comparisons.
questions.question: He is ___ as his brother.

questions.def: Question word order: What ARE you doing?
questions.question: What you are doing now?

questions.def: Use "more" with longer adjectives in comparative form.
questions.question: This car is ___ than the other one.

questions.def: "How many" is used to ask about quantity.
questions.question: ___ many people came to the party?

questions.def: "Less" is used for uncountable nouns and adjectives.
questions.question: She is ___ intelligent than her sister.

questions.def: "Farther" refers to physical distance.
questions.question: This city is ___ from here than I thought.

questions.def: "What" is used to ask about things.
questions.question: ___ do you usually eat for breakfast?

questions.def: "Worst" is the superlative of bad.
questions.question: This is the ___ movie I've seen this year.

questions.def: Third-person singular present tense: asks.
questions.question: He ask me if I want to go.

questions.def: "Much" is used with uncountable nouns (money).
questions.question: I don't have as ___ money as you.

questions.def: "How" is used to ask about age.
questions.question: ___ old are you?

questions.def: Use "-er" for short adverbs in comparative form.
questions.question: She runs ___ than her brother.

questions.def: "Less" is the comparative of "little" for uncountable nouns.
questions.question: I have ___ time than you.

questions.def: "What" is used to ask about things in general.
questions.question: ___ is your favorite color?

questions.def: "Smartest" is the superlative of smart.
questions.question: He is the ___ student in the class.

questions.def: "Easier" is the comparative form of easy.
questions.question: This test is ___ than the last one.

questions.def: "Where" is used to ask about location.
questions.question: ___ do you live?

questions.def: "Older" is the comparative form of old.
questions.question: She is ___ than I am.

questions.def: Use "more" with adverbs ending in -ly in comparative form.
questions.question: He drives ___ than his brother.

questions.def: "What" is used to ask for someone's name.
questions.question: ___ is your name?

questions.def: "Sweeter" is the comparative form of sweet.
questions.question: This cake is ___ than that one.

questions.def: Use 'Did' for past simple questions.
questions.question: ___ you go to the park yesterday?

questions.def: Use 'more' for longer adjectives when comparing.
questions.question: This book is ___ than that one.

questions.def: Add '-er' to short adjectives to form comparatives.
questions.question: He is ___ than his brother.

questions.def: 'What' asks about a thing or choice.
questions.question: ___ is your favorite color?

questions.def: 'Best' is the superlative of 'good', using 'the'.
questions.question: She is ___ student in the class.
